outcome: Incidence of visible strings of IUDs
cohort: Women who underwent postplacental insertion of Copper-T 380A IUDs following vaginal or caesarean delivery
finding: Visualisation of IUD strings after postplacental vaginal insertion is more common than after intra-caesarean insertion.
mod_finding: Visualisation of IUD strings after postplacental vaginal insertion is more common than after intra-caesarean insertion.
